title: When CRT scanlines work in cyberpunk art (and when they kill the piece)
excerpt: CRT scanlines, chromatic aberration, VHS grain — when the retro filter earns its place in cyberpunk art and when it flattens an otherwise solid portrait.
seo_title: Cyberpunk Scanlines Art: When CRT Treatment Works
seo_description: When CRT scanlines, chromatic aberration, and VHS grain belong on a cyberpunk portrait — and when they date the piece. A painter's honest take.
